关于舞蹈房的故事(A Story about the dance studio): 一篇关于兴趣爱好的A2短文:汤姆与山姆的经历和小计划。
Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the art classroom. Tom is reading a book about science. What's more, the child draws a picture.
Tom's favorite animal is the bird. Last Thursday, Tom and Sam went to the dance studio. The weather was rainy that day. Also, the scout reported the enemy's position to his captain.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the dance studio by bike. Sam is interested in dancing. Both of them like noodles and tea. Also, policymakers debated the new school meal rules.
Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Tom plays table tennis with Sam every Thursday. Tom hopes to visit London one day.
